$schema_note: Maps release artifacts to their Nexus Mods targets. To publish, create a GitHub Release in the PUBLIC repo tagged '<artifact>-v<version>' (e.g. audible-traffic-radios-v1.0.0). The release.yml workflow parses the tag, stages each contentDir into its installDir, zips the stage as '<fileBaseName>_v<version>.zip' so the game trees sit at the zip root, attaches the zip to the release, and uploads to Nexus. See RELEASING.md.
$paths_note: contentDir = repo folder whose CONTENTS ship. installDir = path inside the zip those contents are placed at. This mod ships one game tree, red4ext: the plugin DLL. Nothing is built in CI; the committed release DLL is what ships.
$file_id_note: The Nexus file id is NOT stored here. It lives in a REPOSITORY VARIABLE named NEXUS_FILE_ID_AUDIBLE_TRAFFIC_RADIOS in the public repo, set under Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > Variables. It does not exist until the mod's first file has been uploaded to Nexus by hand. Get it from the mod page's Files tab > 'API Info' (Nexus labels it 'Group ID'). Do NOT use the file_id from the public v1 API - that is a different id space.
$mod_page_note: nexus_mod_id is the number in the mod page URL.
